title: Implement scraper base class and data models
description:
Create src/psp_etl/scrape/base.py with:
- BoardInfo dataclass: vendor, model, socket (AM4/AM5), url
- BiosUpdate dataclass: board, bios_version, download_url, release_date, agesa_version
- VendorScraper ABC with: list_boards(), list_bios_updates(board), download(update, dest_dir)
- Common download logic: SHA-256 dedup, progress reporting, retry with backoff
- Rate limiting support (per-vendor configurable delay)
- Use httpx async client

comments.author: driver
comments.content: Design decision: Scrapers use sync httpx.Client (not async). Methods are regular def, not async def. This simplifies click integration.
